name: cineId
meaning: CINnn: cinematic id passed to Cine_Start (+0x2 padding)

name: cineBox
meaning: CINnnBOX list[0], or NULL (Cine_Start then may use WAR_IDO_CINBBOX)

name: actBox
meaning: CINnnACTBOX list[0]: the trigger box tested against the Wolf's pos; also the key for msg 0x1400

name: flags
meaning: CINnnFLAGS, passed to Cine_Start as CineFlags. Also read here: 1 confirm-press, 0x80 has text, 0x2000 repeatable, 0x8000 save first

name: played
meaning: set when started (unless flags & 0x2000); blocks retrigger; cleared by msg 0x1400

name: text
meaning: Text_GetClassString(manager, CINnnTEXT & 0xff) when flags & 0x80, else NULL; Cine_Start's text argument

name: started
meaning: set to 1 on every Cine_Start from this trigger; no reader found (write-only)
